description: Laptops, smartphones, tablets and wearables from the brands you trust.

subcategories.name: Laptops
subcategories.description: Ultrabooks, creator machines and gaming laptops for work, study and play.

products.name: Apple MacBook Air 13" (M2)
products.short: Strikingly thin 13.6" laptop with the Apple M2 chip and up to 18 hours of battery life.
products.description:
The redesigned MacBook Air is impossibly thin and completely silent thanks to its fanless design, powered by the Apple M2 chip.

  • 13.6" Liquid Retina display, 500 nits
  • 8-core CPU and 8-core GPU
  • 1080p FaceTime HD camera and four-speaker sound system
  • MagSafe charging plus two Thunderbolt ports

products.name: Dell XPS 13 9370
products.short: Compact 13.3" InfinityEdge ultrabook with 8th-gen Intel Core i7 — clearance price.
products.description:
The XPS 13 9370 packs a 13.3" InfinityEdge display into a body smaller than most 11" laptops, with a machined aluminium and carbon-fibre chassis.

  • Intel Core i7-8550U quad-core processor
  • 13.3" Full HD InfinityEdge display
  • Three USB-C ports (two Thunderbolt 3)
  • Up to 19 hours of battery life

products.name: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 1 (Refurbished)
products.short: Grade-A refurbished business ultrabook with the legendary ThinkPad keyboard and TrackPoint.
products.description:
The original carbon-fibre ThinkPad X1 Carbon, professionally refurbished, tested and backed by a 6-month Vela Tech warranty.

  • Intel Core i5-3427U processor
  • 14" HD+ anti-glare display
  • Spill-resistant backlit keyboard with TrackPoint
  • Fresh 256 GB SSD and Windows 10 Pro

products.name: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14 (2025)
products.short: 14" OLED gaming laptop with AMD Ryzen AI 9 and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-series graphics.
products.description:
The Zephyrus G14 squeezes flagship gaming and creator performance into a CNC-milled aluminium 14-inch chassis.

  • AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 processor
  • 14" 3K ROG Nebula OLED, 120 Hz, 0.2 ms
  • NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 or RTX 5070 Ti
  • Slash Lighting LED strip on the lid

products.name: Framework Laptop 13 (AMD Ryzen 7040)
products.short: The repairable, upgradeable 13.5" laptop with swappable expansion cards.
products.description:
Framework Laptop 13 is built to be opened, repaired and upgraded — every part has a QR code and a guide.

  • AMD Ryzen 7040 series processors
  • 13.5" 3:2 display, 2256 x 1504
  • Four swappable expansion card slots
  • Replaceable battery, keyboard, screen and mainboard

products.name: Microsoft Surface Laptop 7 13.8"
products.short: Copilot+ PC with Snapdragon X Plus, all-day battery and a 13.8" PixelSense touchscreen.
products.description:
Surface Laptop 7 is a Copilot+ PC built around the Snapdragon X Plus chip, delivering fast AI features and a battery that lasts the whole workday.

  • Qualcomm Snapdragon X Plus (10-core)
  • 13.8" PixelSense Flow touchscreen, up to 120 Hz
  • 16 GB RAM
  • Up to 20 hours of video playback

products.name: Apple MacBook Pro 14" (M3)
products.short: 14.2" Liquid Retina XDR pro laptop powered by the Apple M3 chip.
products.description:
MacBook Pro with M3 brings pro-level performance and the best display ever in a Mac notebook to an even more accessible model.

  • Apple M3 chip, 8-core CPU, 10-core GPU
  • 14.2" Liquid Retina XDR display, up to 1600 nits HDR
  • HDMI, SDXC slot, two Thunderbolt ports, MagSafe 3
  • Up to 22 hours of battery life

subcategories.name: Smartphones
subcategories.description: The latest iPhone, Galaxy, Pixel and Android flagships and value phones.

products.name: Apple iPhone 15 Pro
products.short: Titanium design, A17 Pro chip, Action button and a 48MP Pro camera system.
products.description:
iPhone 15 Pro is forged in aerospace-grade titanium and powered by the A17 Pro chip, with a pro camera system and USB-C.

  • 6.1" Super Retina XDR with ProMotion and Always-On
  • 48MP Main, 12MP Ultra Wide and 3x Telephoto
  • Customizable Action button
  • USB-C with USB 3 speeds

products.name: Apple iPhone 15
products.short: Dynamic Island, 48MP Main camera and USB-C in a colour-infused glass design.
products.description:
iPhone 15 brings Dynamic Island and a 48MP Main camera to the standard iPhone, in a colour-infused back glass.

  • 6.1" Super Retina XDR display
  • A16 Bionic chip
  • 48MP Main camera with 2x Telephoto option
  • USB-C connector

products.name: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra
products.short: Titanium flagship with built-in S Pen, 200MP camera and Galaxy AI.
products.description:
Galaxy S24 Ultra combines a titanium frame, a flat 6.8" display and Galaxy AI features like Live Translate and Circle to Search.

  • Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 for Galaxy
  • 200MP main camera with 5x and 3x optical zoom
  • Built-in S Pen
  • 7 years of OS and security updates

products.name: Google Pixel 8
products.short: Google's compact AI phone with Tensor G3, Magic Editor and 7 years of updates.
products.description:
Pixel 8 is the helpful phone engineered by Google, with Tensor G3 and smart photo tools like Best Take and Magic Editor.

  • 6.2" Actua display, 120 Hz
  • Google Tensor G3
  • 50MP main and 12MP ultrawide cameras
  • 7 years of OS and security updates

products.name: Samsung Galaxy A55 5G
products.short: Mid-range Galaxy with metal frame, 120 Hz Super AMOLED and IP67 protection.
products.description:
Galaxy A55 5G brings a premium metal frame, a bright 120 Hz display and Samsung Knox security to an affordable price.

  • 6.6" Super AMOLED, 120 Hz
  • Exynos 1480 processor
  • 50MP OIS main camera
  • IP67 dust and water resistance

products.name: Xiaomi Redmi Note 12
products.short: Best-selling budget phone with a 120 Hz AMOLED screen and 5000 mAh battery.
products.description:
Redmi Note 12 delivers a smooth 120 Hz AMOLED display and two-day battery life at a price that's hard to beat.

  • 6.67" FHD+ AMOLED, 120 Hz
  • Snapdragon 685 processor
  • 50MP triple camera
  • 5000 mAh battery with 33W fast charging

products.name: Nothing Phone (2)
products.short: Transparent design with the Glyph Interface, Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1 and clean Nothing OS.
products.description:
Phone (2) refines Nothing's iconic transparent design with a customizable Glyph Interface and flagship performance.

  • 6.7" LTPO OLED, 1-120 Hz
  • Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1
  • Dual 50MP cameras
  • Glyph Interface light notifications

products.name: OnePlus 13
products.short: Flagship killer with Snapdragon 8 Elite, Hasselblad cameras and 100W charging.
products.description:
OnePlus 13 pairs the Snapdragon 8 Elite with a Hasselblad-tuned triple 50MP camera and one of the fastest charging systems available.

  • 6.82" 2K LTPO AMOLED, 120 Hz
  • Snapdragon 8 Elite
  • Triple 50MP Hasselblad camera
  • 6000 mAh battery, 100W wired and 50W wireless charging

subcategories.name: Tablets
subcategories.description: iPads, Galaxy Tabs, 2-in-1s and e-readers for creating, studying and reading.

products.name: Apple iPad Air (M2)
products.short: Thin and light iPad Air with the M2 chip, landscape camera and Apple Pencil Pro support.
products.description:
iPad Air with M2 is serious performance in a thin and light design, now in two sizes.

  • Apple M2 chip with 8-core CPU
  • Liquid Retina display, 11" or 13"
  • Landscape 12MP front camera with Center Stage
  • Works with Apple Pencil Pro and Magic Keyboard

products.name: Apple iPad (10th Generation)
products.short: All-screen 10.9" iPad in four bold colours with A14 Bionic and USB-C.
products.description:
The colourfully reimagined iPad has an all-screen design, a landscape front camera and USB-C — perfect for school, work and play.

  • 10.9" Liquid Retina display
  • A14 Bionic chip
  • 12MP landscape front camera
  • Touch ID in the top button

products.name: Apple iPad Pro 11" (M4)
products.short: The thinnest Apple product ever, with the M4 chip and an Ultra Retina XDR tandem OLED display.
products.description:
iPad Pro with M4 features a breakthrough Ultra Retina XDR display built on tandem OLED technology, in an impossibly thin design.

  • Apple M4 chip
  • 11" Ultra Retina XDR (tandem OLED), ProMotion
  • Thunderbolt / USB 4 port
  • Face ID and landscape TrueDepth camera

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Tab S9
products.short: 11" Dynamic AMOLED 2X Android tablet with S Pen in the box and IP68 water resistance.
products.description:
Galaxy Tab S9 brings a vivid Dynamic AMOLED 2X screen, the included S Pen and IP68 protection to a premium Android tablet.

  • 11" Dynamic AMOLED 2X, 120 Hz
  • Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 for Galaxy
  • S Pen included
  • IP68 water and dust resistance

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Tab A9+
products.short: Affordable 11" family tablet with 90 Hz display and quad speakers.
products.description:
Galaxy Tab A9+ is a big-screen tablet for streaming, browsing and homework at an everyday price.

  • 11" display, 90 Hz
  • Snapdragon 695 processor
  • Quad speakers with Dolby Atmos
  • 7040 mAh battery

products.name: Microsoft Surface Pro 9
products.short: Tablet flexibility and laptop performance with 12th-gen Intel Core and a 13" 120 Hz touchscreen.
products.description:
Surface Pro 9 is the 2-in-1 that goes from tablet to laptop to studio with its built-in kickstand and detachable keyboard.

  • 12th Gen Intel Core i5-1235U
  • 13" PixelSense Flow display, 120 Hz
  • Two Thunderbolt 4 ports
  • Signature Keyboard and Slim Pen 2 compatible

products.name: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite (11th Gen)
products.short: Glare-free 6.8" e-reader with adjustable warm light and weeks of battery life.
products.description:
Kindle Paperwhite reads like real paper, even in bright sunlight, and is waterproof so you can read at the beach or in the bath.

  • 6.8" 300 ppi glare-free display
  • Adjustable warm light
  • Up to 10 weeks of battery life
  • IPX8 waterproof, USB-C charging

subcategories.name: Smartwatches & Wearables
subcategories.description: Smartwatches, running watches and fitness trackers to keep you moving.

products.name: Apple Watch Series 8
products.short: Advanced health smartwatch with temperature sensing, Crash Detection and an Always-On Retina display.
products.description:
Apple Watch Series 8 helps you stay healthy, active and connected, with new temperature sensing and Crash Detection.

  • Always-On Retina display
  • ECG, blood oxygen and temperature sensing
  • Crash Detection and Fall Detection
  • Up to 18 hours of battery life (36 h in Low Power Mode)

products.name: Apple Watch Ultra 2
products.short: The most rugged and capable Apple Watch, with a 49 mm titanium case and 3000-nit display.
products.description:
Apple Watch Ultra 2 is built for endurance, exploration and adventure, with the brightest Apple display ever and up to 72 hours of battery.

  • 49 mm aerospace-grade titanium case
  • 3000-nit Always-On Retina display
  • Precision dual-frequency GPS
  • Up to 36 hours of battery (72 h in Low Power Mode)

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Watch6
products.short: Slim Wear OS smartwatch with a bigger Sapphire Crystal display and advanced sleep coaching.
products.description:
Galaxy Watch6 gives you a larger, brighter screen in a slimmer bezel, plus personalised sleep coaching and heart-rate zones.

  • Super AMOLED with Sapphire Crystal glass
  • BioActive sensor: heart rate, ECG, body composition
  • Wear OS powered by Samsung
  • Up to 40 hours of battery life

products.name: Garmin Forerunner 265
products.short: AMOLED GPS running watch with training readiness, HRV status and race-day insights.
products.description:
Forerunner 265 is the running smartwatch with a bright AMOLED display and the training tools you need to race your best.

  • 1.3" AMOLED touchscreen with buttons
  • Multi-band GPS
  • Training Readiness, HRV Status and daily workouts
  • Up to 13 days of battery in smartwatch mode

products.name: Fitbit Inspire 3
products.short: Easy-to-use fitness tracker with colour display, 24/7 heart rate and 10-day battery.
products.description:
Inspire 3 is a slim, comfortable tracker that helps you build healthy habits with heart-rate tracking, sleep stages and reminders to move.

  • Colour touchscreen display
  • 24/7 heart rate and SpO2
  • Sleep stages and Sleep Score
  • Up to 10 days of battery life

products.name: Xiaomi Smart Band 8
products.short: Best-selling 1.62" AMOLED fitness band with 150+ sport modes and 16-day battery.
products.description:
Xiaomi Smart Band 8 tracks your workouts, sleep and health around the clock with a bright AMOLED screen and a pebble-inspired design.

  • 1.62" AMOLED display, 60 Hz
  • 150+ sport modes
  • Heart rate, SpO2 and sleep tracking
  • Up to 16 days of battery life

products.name: Google Pixel Watch 2
products.short: Domed Wear OS watch with Fitbit health tracking, faster chip and all-day battery.
products.description:
Pixel Watch 2 combines the best of Google and Fitbit, with a faster processor, more accurate heart rate and Safety Check.

  • 41 mm domed AMOLED display
  • Fitbit heart rate, stress and sleep tracking
  • Qualcomm SW5100 processor
  • 24-hour battery with Always-On Display
